target_customer: Initially data and AI teams building data applications; later finance teams and practitioners needing financial analysis and reporting
problem: Building data and AI applications required heavy engineering; later, financial analysis depended on spreadsheets and rigid tools.
business_model: B2B SaaS platform; pricing not found
product_category: Data/AI platform, later AI financial analysis agents

founders.name: Ken Van Haren
founders.background_notes: YC says Square and Google; TechCrunch says Google data scientist.

founders.name: Chris Stanley
founders.background_notes: Square data scientist per TechCrunch (2023); no YC bio.

technical_complexity.rationale: Platform with prebuilt connectors and a web IDE for building and shipping data and AI use cases (TechCrunch 2023); standard platform engineering with some hard parts.

defensibility.rationale: Crowded MLOps category with funded competitors named by TechCrunch; no moat evidenced.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source on incumbents copying or acquiring Patterns. The 2023 AI wave shifted the market toward LLM tools.

market_need_then: TechCrunch (March 2023) says Patterns aimed to remove routine data science work; no spend or demand data found.

pivots.from: General AI/data platform with connectors and IDE (2023)
pivots.to: AI agents for self-serve analytics, then financial analysis and reporting
pivots.why: Not stated by sources; inferred from changing site and YC descriptions, exact date unknown.

outcome_analysis: Patterns raised a reported $2.5M pre-seed around March 2023 for a data and AI platform, then its site and YC listing shifted to AI analytics and financial-analysis agents. YC now lists it as inactive, but no shutdown announcement or reason was found. Pivot_failed is a tentative inference from the product change followed by inactivity, not a stated reason. Later-dated (March 2023) TechCrunch coverage named MLOps rivals Galileo, Qwak, Diveplane, Tecton, Arize, Iterative, Comet and Weights & Biases.
notes: Status Inactive per YC but exit type recorded as unknown because no source on closure was found. Pivot date and reason are inferred. Round date uses TechCrunch article date (2023-03-09) and 'recently closed'. Crunchbase returned 403. YC page and TechCrunch differ on founders' prior employers. Failure factor is tentative. Competitors named in the March 2023 article are excluded from competition_at_founding because they are dated about 20 months after the S21 batch.
